Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our compliance team is doing a quick follow-up as part of the SIG/CAIQ intake for BrightPath's procurement process. Can you please provide the following artifacts so we can close the access control section?

- SSO metadata (IdP/SP) and a sample SAML assertion (redacted to remove PII is okay)

- RBAC role matrix or user->role export showing scope of admin vs. end-user roles
- Statement of retention for audit logs (how long token/session/audit logs are retained)

If you prefer, a secure bundle link is fine — we just need the items above and a short note explaining any redactions. Targeted deadline for the buyer committee is EOD Nov 4th.

Best,

Jonas / team — thanks for the quick turn. A couple quick follow-ups after a cursory review: 

- The SCIM delta CSV looks good; can you also include an index or README that explains the event_type values? That helps our audit team map events to SIG controls.
- We still need a redacted SAML assertion sample showing attributes you expose at assertion time (eduPersonPrincipalName / email / roles/ groups). A fully redacted example is fine as long as attribute names and value formats are visible.
- Can you confirm log retention windows? We require 12 months for audit/provisioning logs for our vendor policy.

If you can send the assertion sample and retention statement today (Nov 3) that would keep us on track. Also, for delivery, a secure ShareFile link is ideal — do not send assertions over plaintext email.

Thanks,
Eva

Eva — thanks for the notes. Short update and delivery plan: 

- SAML assertion: Rishi attached a redacted sample (saml_assertion_sample_redacted.xml) in the ShareFile package. The assertion preserves attribute names and value formats; all PII values replaced with deterministic hashes to preserve uniqueness where useful for matching.
- SCIM README: Grace added SCIM_event_code_readme.md to the folder explaining event_type mapping (provision, update, deactivate).
- Log retention: Stephanie confirmed our audit/provisioning/event logs are retained for 15 months by default. We will include a short PDF (access_log_retention_policy.pdf) that spells out retention windows for: provisioning deltas (15 months), audit logs (15 months), KV cache traces (30 days). If BrightPath requires an explicit 12-month window only, we can provide a formal attestation.

Delivery: all artifacts are uploaded to a secure ShareFile bundle: https://sharefile.redwood.ai/s/brightpath/SAML_SCIM_package_20261103. Files included: scim_delta_export_202610.csv, RBAC_ROLE_MATRIX_V2.xlsx, saml_assertion_sample_redacted.xml, access_log_retention_policy.pdf, SCIM_event_code_readme.md.

Let me know if you want a short statement on redaction methodology; happy to add. If BrightPath needs a signed attestation, I can route a brief DocuSign for the compliance note.

Best,
